def valid(book):
    return bool(book and book.quality.integrity=='valid' and book.quality.lifecycle=='live')

def decode(self,frame):
    cpu=time.thread_time_ns()
    result=original_decode(self,frame)

    return result

            category='ignored_or_staged_book'

            category='committed_invalid_or_non_live_book'
        elif not was_valid:
            category='cold_or_recovery_bootstrap'

    failure=None

            observe(self,frame,before,failure)
